method: All INSERTs walked recursively from modelspace (block _МАФ is inserted at 0,0 with identity); blocks drawn twice (modelspace + _МАФ) de-duplicated by name+XY; legend samples at x<-10000 dropped; inside test = insertion point (canopy: fill centroid) in the GPZU polygon. Rotation = world angle of block X axis. The canopy hatch block is drawn twice with different corners (rot 25.67 vs 205.67) — same footprint, counted once.

viz_transform.model: viz_xy_m = R(rot_deg) * dwg_xy_m + t_m (rigid, scale 1); viz scene units cm -> multiply by 100
viz_transform.matching: DWG block-extents centre (canopy: hatch-block centroid) vs viz bbox centre, nearest same-type within 1.0 m
